claimed_coverage: Tests verify that CI scripts (.ci/test.sh and .ci/test_windows.ps1) do not contain --user flags in pip install commands, preventing cross-job contamination in CI pipelines.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix.patch removes --user flags from all pip install commands in .ci/test.sh (lines 120, 158, 203, 215, 225, 241, 251, 262, 272, 284) and .ci/test_windows.ps1 (lines 100, 107, 110) to prevent user-site directory persistence across CI jobs.
issue_context_used: The issue.md describes how pip install --user causes cross-job contamination in CI pipelines because the user-site directory persists across jobs, leading to stale package installations.
notes: Created hidden tests that verify the absence of --user flags in pip install commands within CI scripts. Tests fail on buggy version (expected) and pass on fixed version.
